pf.license.need: No license is needed for this work in most places. A registration or certificate the state asks for is the business's own to add. It is optional, and nothing is looked up.
pf.license.ask: Any registration, certificate or insurance the business wants shown, as the business's own word.
pf.license.who holds it: The business. No person license is needed by default.
pf.license.how it's checked: Rosie checks none of it and never says it was checked. Anything shown is the business's own word.
pf.license.blocks going live: Nothing. Licenses and insurance are optional and never block going live.
pf.license.never claimed: Rosie never says a license, certificate or insurance is confirmed; anything shown is the business's own word.
pf.license.insurance or bond: The business's own choice, shown only as its own word.

pf.services.shape: College advising: strategy sessions, essay reviews and an application plan, by video, by phone or at the office (flow A), and a campus visit at a family's home or a family information night at a host's place (flow B). Every new family starts with a free intro call with the student and a parent. Advice is not a promise of admission.

pf.visit.check-in: At the office: the code at the desk. By video or phone: the advisor asks for the code at the start. At home: the code at the door.
pf.visit.at the visit: The advisor goes over the plan and the deadlines. Nothing is bought through Rosie: fees to schools, testing and exam fees are paid to those organizations.
pf.visit.work changes: Extra time on a plan, an extra essay or a longer session is priced and OK'd before it's added.
pf.visit.what proves it's done: The code, or DONE when the meeting ends.

pf.money.before: A strategy session: paid in full when booked (refunded 24 hours or more before). An essay review or a home visit: a card saved. An application package: a deposit now, the rest after. Family info nights: nothing taken.
pf.money.after: The saved card is charged when the advisor texts DONE; an application package's rest goes to the front desk or the bill; a quick check pays at the desk; an info night's bill is texted after.
pf.money.school fees: Never through Rosie: school application fees and testing fees are paid to those organizations.
pf.money.fees: Late-cancel fee: $20 (an essay review) or $89 (a home visit), only with the advisor's OK; no fee on silence.
pf.money.tax: None by default; the state form says if the service is taxed there.

pf.messages.never in a text: A student's grades, test scores, school records, learning needs, family money or aid, health, and anything the family shares about the student's life.
pf.messages.card or document texted by mistake: Not kept or passed on; the family is told once where it goes instead (the secure page).
pf.messages.staff texts: the student's first name and the kind of session; details on the secure page
pf.messages.minors: A student under 18 is never texted directly by Rosie; the parent gets the texts.

pf.staff.roles: Advisors (some with teaching or counseling-office experience, shown as their own word), a front desk person.
pf.staff.licenses: None needed. Experience is the advisor's own word, shown as stated.
pf.staff.who OKs: Sam OKs any price made for one family.
pf.staff.stand-ins: Another advisor who knows the student's list; a family that asked for their advisor by name is asked first; nobody moves on silence.
pf.staff.after hours: None: bookings are by text or on the page.

pf.rules.advising: Advising isn't legal, financial or counseling advice; the advisor says so when asked. Fees to schools and testing organizations are never taken by Rosie. An essay is kept only with the family's yes.

matter most.a student who says an adult is hurting t: 911 or the local child-protection line at once; no booking.
matter most.a parent and an adult student who disagr: The adult student decides for themselves; Rosie never tells one party what the other shared.
matter most.a request for an admission promise: The advisor says no promise is made.
matter most.a late cancel: The fee only with the advisor's OK; no fee on silence.
matter most.an essay sent as a photo: Used only for the review; not shared.

pf.edges.the rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.
